turns: Do you ship to Canada?

expect.answer: Yes, to every province and territory; 5 to 9 business days; $14; no free shipping to Canada.

turns: How do I change my email?

expect.answer: Account, Settings, Email, then click the link sent to the new address.

turns: how long does standard shipping take

expect.answer: 3 to 6 business days after it leaves the warehouse.

turns: Is shipping free?

expect.answer: Free standard shipping on US orders of $50 or more; $6.95 under $50. Must not say $35.

turns: Can I return a candle I already burned?

expect.answer: No, burned candles can't be returned.

turns: I returned something last week, when do I get my money back?

expect.answer: Refunded within 2 business days of reaching the warehouse, then 5 to 10 business days to show.

turns: I want to swap a blue throw for the green one

expect.answer: No direct exchanges: return it and place a new order.

turns: My vase arrived smashed

expect.answer: Send a photo of item and box within 14 days; free replacement or full refund; no need to send it back.

turns: Can I cancel the order I placed 20 minutes ago?

expect.answer: Yes, within 1 hour under Account, Orders.

turns: Do you take PayPal?

expect.answer: Yes, PayPal is accepted.

turns: I see a pending charge from you but I cancelled my order

expect.answer: Holds aren't charges and drop off in 3 to 5 business days. Should not look up charges or promise a refund.

turns: Where can I get an invoice for my company?

expect.answer: Account, Orders, Invoice; update billing address first to add company name or tax ID.

turns: Do gift cards expire?

expect.answer: No, they never expire.

turns: How do I skip my next Fernhill Box?

expect.answer: Account, Subscriptions, before the 1st of the month it ships.

turns: My lamp stopped working after 8 months, is that covered?

expect.answer: Lighting has a 2-year warranty against defects; send order number and a photo.

turns: How should I wash linen sheets?
And can I put them in the dryer?

expect.answer: First: cold or warm water, gentle, mild detergent, no bleach. Second: tumble dry low or hang to dry.

turns: What are your support hours? Can I call you?

expect.answer: Monday to Friday 9 am to 6 pm Eastern; there is no phone line.

turns: Do you ship to Germany?

expect.answer: No, only US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand.

turns: Do you offer assembly service for the oak bookshelf?

expect.answer: No article covers assembly; should hand off instead of guessing.

turns: Are your candles vegan and what wax do you use?

expect.answer: No article covers candle ingredients; should hand off instead of guessing.

You charged me 26.50 two times!!
There are two payments of $49.99 on my card from you
I got billed twice for the $128 order
